description: This circular walk explores the area surrounding the Oxfordshire settlements of Charlbury and Finstock. The varied route includes country lanes, pretty lakes and peaceful woodland trails through Wychwood Forest. There's also fine views of the River Evenlode and the surrounding countryside of the Cotswolds AONB to enjoy. The route runs for just under 9 miles following a series of local footpaths, bridleways and forestry trails. You can continue your walking by visiting nearby Chadlington or picking up the circular Glympton and Kiddington Park Estates Walk .
